project: ADSPA Academic Deadline and Study Planning Agent
features: central academic dashboard with daily briefing
course, semester, coursework, and study material records
deadline countdowns, custom reminders, workload risk, and recovery plans
dependency-aware assignment lifecycle, checklist, and submission confirmation
availability-aware daily, weekly, and monthly planning with breaks and rescheduling
exam countdown, syllabus coverage, quiz results, weak-topic tracking, and spaced repetition
source-grounded material search, question extraction, summaries, flashcards, and practice questions
research projects, milestones, meetings, feedback, and experiment tracking
configurable workload optimization and academic natural-language commands
browser voice input and speech output
Google Calendar sync and opt-in Gmail reminders
persistent SQLite-backed scheduler, in-app, browser, and optional Telegram reminders
SQLite persistence with legacy JSON migration
